capabilities: Sync vault files to S3-compatible object storage
Run manual or automatic syncs per vault and device
Sync deletions and keep conflict copies
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin; despite the name, it only syncs vault files through object storage.
extras: Detailed design lives in a separate docs file (docs/obsidian-oss-sync-mvp.md); README includes Chinese and English sections and developer build instructions. Config export can include the Access Key and Secret.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a paid service, and there is no built-in way to sync a vault through a user's own S3-compatible object storage.

relations.evidence: Cohere works with S3-compatible providers such as Cloudflare R2, Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS

summary: Vault sync plugin that replicates notes through S3-compatible object storage such as Cloudflare R2, Aliyun OSS, or MinIO.
